title: On caring for user data: NeoVim caused Vim undo files to be deleted
summary: This is not AI/ML content; it is a Hacker News discussion about NeoVim deleting Vim undo files and broader concerns over software's duty of care to user data. The linked article and 340 comments debate data loss, tool design responsibility, and user trust. It contains no machine learning, LLM, or AI engineering material.
